note: A signal saying what changed. The signal is the same whatever moved the room, so that it carries nothing to its address's mediator, to a push gateway or to the platform push service but that something arrived; on the sealed tiers the host could not know the kind in any case.
A signal counting the changes. One signal per arming exists so that neither the number nor the rhythm of signals says how busy the room was.
No version. Without it a reader cannot tell a signal it has already caught up past from one it has not.
